name: Ephrath
title: Caleb's wife and matriarch
summary: Ephrath (also called Ephratah) was the wife of Caleb, son of Hezron, from the tribe of Judah. She is known as the mother of Hur, and through her descendants she became a matriarch to important figures, including Bezalel, who built the tabernacle. The name Ephrath is also associated with the Bethlehem area (Ephratah).

keyEvents.title: Caleb's marriage to Ephrath
keyEvents.description: After Hezron died, Caleb took Ephrath as his wife, and she bore him a son named Hur.

keyEvents.title: Hezron's descendants through Ephrath
keyEvents.description: Ephrath is mentioned in connection with Hezron's lineage as an important matriarch in the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Ephrath as the matriarch of Hur
keyEvents.description: Hur, son of Ephrathah, was the father of Uri, who in turn was the father of Bezalel, the craftsman who built the tabernacle.

keyEvents.title: Descendants of Caleb and Ephrathah
keyEvents.description: The descendants of Ephrathah through Hur played important roles, including as founders of Bethlehem and other cities.

keyEvents.title: Connection to Bethlehem-Ephrathah
keyEvents.description: The name Ephrathah is closely linked to Bethlehem, the city later known as the City of David and the place where the Messiah was to be born.
